checks.command: pytest -q tests/test_asr_pareto.py tests/test_detailed_benchmark.py tests/test_benchmark_ranking.py tests/test_comparison_scope.py tests/test_evaluation.py tests/test_evaluation_metrics.py

supported_claims: The primary evaluation runner includes CER and S/D/I while legacy score consumers retain their prior metric shape.
The detailed v7 benchmark source-text lock and scorer equivalence checks pass unchanged.
Candidate benchmark reports are compared only when they share the same frozen suite digest, manifest, case identities, audio hashes, references, foregrounds, conditions and input coverage.
Pareto candidate ranking is based on matched benchmark suite evidence; cross-benchmark comparison is rejected.
limitations: This validates comparison contracts and code paths, not new matched model runs or a candidate ranking result.
Historical frozen benchmark failures remain untouched.
